name_reason: fd2_ prefix correct (game fn); _15 is a valid domain spell_id (0x15 = 祛麻術 cure-paralysis, support spell, table[0x15] @ 0x51D55) and must be kept; 'dispatch' is accurate (dispatch-table entry). BUT the '_aa8' suffix is a Ghidra address residue: aa8 = 0x22AA8 & 0xFFF = the worker fd2_apply_status_effect_with_anim @ 0x00022aa8 that this entry reaches (via the shared tail). Per naming rule, address residue must be removed. Replacing the residue with the worker's semantic role yields fd2_cast_spell_15_apply_status_effect (sibling fd2_cast_spell_14_dispatch_aa8 @ 0x22A85 carries the same _aa8 residue and would rename to fd2_cast_spell_14_apply_status_effect). NOTE: rename is RECORDED ONLY, not applied this stage.
stage2_review: FAMILY OVERRIDE -> fd2_cast_spell_15_dispatch (not _apply_status_effect). The 0x14-0x1b spell dispatch thin-wrappers are unified to fd2_cast_spell_NN_dispatch: _aa8/_cda are worker-address residue (0x22AA8/0x22CDA) stripped per the no-address-residue rule (siblings 0x14/0x16 already strip to _dispatch). Worker identity is carried by the worker's own name, not the wrapper.
purpose: Spell dispatch-table entry for spell_id 0x15 (祛麻術, cure-paralysis): forwards to the shared status-effect-with-anim worker with effect/sprite id 0x26.
logic_summary: Thin dispatch wrapper. Stack-probe (__CHK 0x18) then a single tail call fd2_apply_status_effect_with_anim(caster, 0x15, n_targets, target_id_array, 0x26). The literal 0x15 is the spell_id and 0x26 is the effect-animation sprite_id (the 0x14 sibling uses 0x25). The worker resets the AoE target counter, deducts caster MP, runs status-cure application + 22-frame icon-shake animation, then conditionally tail-jumps to projectile-paths animation. In the original binary this entry pushes its own sprite_id/spell_id and JMPs at 0x22BDC into the 0x14 body at 0x22A9B to reuse the {push caster + call worker + ADD ESP,0x14 + RET} tail (shared-tail / multi-entry, class 3).
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_15_dispatch_aa8(int caster, int n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: caster unit id; passed through verbatim to the worker as the casting unit.
params.reason: Concise, accurate, no address residue. Matches caster_unit_id semantics used across the spell-dispatch family.

params.name: n_tgt
params.semantics: number of targets in the target id array; passed through verbatim.
params.reason: Accurate abbreviation of n_targets; no residue; consistent with sibling dispatch handlers in this file.

params.name: tgt_arr
params.semantics: pointer to the target unit-id array; cast to int and passed to the worker.
params.reason: Accurate abbreviation of target_id_array; no residue; consistent with sibling dispatch handlers in this file.

returns.semantics: No return value; pure dispatch forwarding.
